import React from 'react'; import { Container, Typography, Paper, Grid, Card, CardContent, Button, Box, } from '@mui/material'; import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'; import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'; const InstitutionDashboard = () => { const { currentUser } = useAuth(); const navigate = useNavigate(); return ( Institution Dashboard {/* Quick Actions */} Quick Actions {/* Institution Summary */} Institution Summary Name: {currentUser?.profile?.name || 'Not set'} Email: {currentUser?.email} Status: {currentUser?.profile?.status || 'Active'} Faculties: {currentUser?.profile?.faculties?.length || 0} {/* Recent Activity */} Welcome to Institution Portal As an institution, you can:
  • Add and manage faculties and departments
  • Create and update course offerings
  • Review student applications
  • Make admission decisions
  • Update your institution profile
 ); }; export default InstitutionDashboard;
